result: Created `gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReaderAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 3 (`junit.framework.TestCase`) test class matching the project's existing JUnit style and `-source 8` constraints. It covers 37 test cases for `JsonReader`: happy-path object/array/scalar reading, long/int boundary and overflow handling, number-as-string/string-as-number coercion, mismatched-type errors, malformed/premature-EOF errors, lenient-vs-strict behavior (non-execute prefix, unquoted/single-quoted strings, comments, multiple top-level values, NaN/Infinity), `skipValue`, `close()`-after-use, null-reader construction, `getPath()`, and escape-sequence decoding. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
